title: cleome chiriquensis
intro: Cleome chiriquensis, commonly known as the Panama spiderflower, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and treat respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cleome chiriquensis include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and its antispasmodic properties, which can help to ease muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of Cleome chiriquensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
